rows.name: Sentora Curator
farm_steps: Use a fresh wallet that holds only the funds you plan to farm, and fund it with about $24.00 of gas (ETH) on Ethereum before you start; keep its seed phrase offline. Cost: about $24.00 of gas (ETH), free to create the wallet. Time: 5 minutes.
Deposit $150 into a Sentora Curator vault on Ethereum and keep the shares. Cost: $150 of capital and about $12.00 of gas (ETH). Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Make one qualifying action each week: top up the vault a little. Do it 5 times across the 30-day hold. Cost: about $12.00 of gas (ETH) a week, $60.00 across the hold. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Hold the position for at least 30 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot. Cost: the $150 stays in the position. Time: 30 days.

Exit rule: withdraw the whole position if Sentora Curator's TVL falls under $1.38B — half today's $2.76B — and do not re-enter on a bounce; a halved TVL means deposits are leaving fast and the farm may not be there at claim time. Cost: free to check. Time: 5 minutes a week.

Review on 2027-02-12 (90 days after the 14 Nov 2026 snapshot): re-check the TVL, the points page and this plan; if the protocol has launched a token by then, claim and stop — the farm is over. Cost: free. Time: 15 minutes.

Sensitivity on a $1000 ticket: at a 5% drop share the net is $-84.38; at a 20% share it is $-75.67 (base 10%: $-81.48). The verdict flips if the share lands far from 10%. Cost: no extra cost. Time: over the 30-day hold.

Hands-on time is about 1.3 hours (15 minutes to set up, 10 minutes a week for 5 weeks, 10 minutes to claim), so the net of $-81.48 is about $-65.18 per hands-on hour. Cost: net $-65.18 per hour. Time: across the hold.

Break-even launch odds are above 100%: the farm never breaks even on odds alone, because the $87.29 total cost (gas plus forgone T-bill yield) is larger than the $5.81 drop even if the token certainly launches. Cost: no extra cost. Time: over the 30-day hold.
Minimum viable ticket: about $33,330 — below that the $84.00 of gas alone eats the drop; above it the drop covers the gas and the forgone yield. Cost: no extra cost. Time: over the 30-day hold.

Before you withdraw, open the protocol's own points or rewards page and claim only from the link it publishes; the claim itself costs about $12.00 of gas (ETH). Cost: about $12.00 of gas (ETH) to claim, and never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.

Verdict SKIP: a $1000 position earns about $5.81 of airdrop against $84.00 of gas and $3.29 of forgone 4% T-bill yield over 7 transactions, net $-81.48: the drop does not cover the gas and the forgone yield, so farm a smaller ticket or wait for a cheaper chain. Deposit $50 of USDC into Katana Pre-Launch on Ethereum and keep the position open. Cost: $50 of capital and about $12.00 of gas (ETH). Time: 15 minutes to set up.
Make one qualifying action each week: make one small qualifying action. Do it 5 times across the 30-day hold. Cost: about $12.00 of gas (ETH) a week, $60.00 across the hold. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Hold the position for at least 30 days so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot. Cost: the $50 stays in the position. Time: 30 days.

Exit rule: withdraw the whole position if Katana Pre-Launch's TVL falls under $8.82M — half today's $17.63M — and do not re-enter on a bounce; a halved TVL means deposits are leaving fast and the farm may not be there at claim time. Cost: free to check. Time: 5 minutes a week.

Review on 2027-02-12 (90 days after the 14 Nov 2026 snapshot): re-check the TVL, the points page and this plan; if the protocol has launched a token by then, claim and stop — the farm is over. Cost: free. Time: 15 minutes.

Sensitivity on a $1000 ticket: at a 5% drop share the net is $-70.84; at a 20% share it is $-21.50 (base 10%: $-54.40). The verdict flips if the share lands far from 10%. Cost: no extra cost. Time: over the 30-day hold.

Hands-on time is about 1.3 hours (15 minutes to set up, 10 minutes a week for 5 weeks, 10 minutes to claim), so the net of $-54.40 is about $-43.52 per hands-on hour. Cost: net $-43.52 per hour. Time: across the hold.

Break-even launch odds are above 100%: the farm never breaks even on odds alone, because the $87.29 total cost (gas plus forgone T-bill yield) is larger than the $32.89 drop even if the token certainly launches. Cost: no extra cost. Time: over the 30-day hold.
Minimum viable ticket: about $2,838 — below that the $84.00 of gas alone eats the drop; above it the drop covers the gas and the forgone yield. Cost: no extra cost. Time: over the 30-day hold.

Before you withdraw, open the protocol's own points or rewards page and claim only from the link it publishes; the claim itself costs about $12.00 of gas (ETH). Cost: about $12.00 of gas (ETH) to claim, and never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.

Verdict SKIP: a $1000 position earns about $32.89 of airdrop against $84.00 of gas and $3.29 of forgone 4% T-bill yield over 7 transactions, net $-54.40: the drop does not cover the gas and the forgone yield, so farm a smaller ticket or wait for a cheaper chain.
